subject: Pilot: regression tripwire + eval-harness integration for Helio
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-10T16:04:00-04:00
Subject: Pilot scope: regression monitoring and canary policies

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost numbers looked promising. We want to run a four-week pilot with Redwood for our patient-summary generator and need to lock down how we detect regressions early. Key asks from our side:

- A lightweight "regression tripwire" that alarms on quality drops for the prompt family attached.
- Integration with our eval harness (internal) so we can run nightly regression checks.
- Canary/rollback policy recommendations for the first two weeks of rollout.

I've attached the first-pass prompt bank (helio_prompt_bank_v1.csv) so your team can see variant prompts. Evan will coordinate infra access if needed.

Can we get a proposed implementation plan + risk controls by early next week?

Best,
Samira
Director of GenAI Product
Helio Health

Attachments: helio_prompt_bank_v1.csv (csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope: regression monitoring and canary policies

Samira — thanks for the prompt bank and the clear asks. High-level plan below; Marissa will follow with the implementation checklist.

1) Eval harness integration: we will wire the Helio harness to our eval-runner. Expected outputs: nightly batch of 500 examples, per-prompt pass/fail, and a token-level cost breakdown.

2) Regression tripwires: suggest two tiers —
- Alert (yellow): 5% drop in top-line utility score for any prompt family over a 24h rolling window.
- Critical (red): 10% drop or sustained degradation for 48h.

3) Canary policy: staged traffic ramp (10% -> 40% -> 100% over 3 days) with automatic rollback on a critical alert or if latency regresses >30% of baseline.

I've attached a short draft integration plan and a pilot canary policy for you to review.

I'll set a kick-off for Tuesday with engineering and CS.

—Jonas
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_eval-harness-integration-plan.md, pilot-canary-fallback-policy.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope: regression monitoring and canary policies

Hi Samira — looping in a proposed implementation checklist for the pilot. This is the actionable list we'll use to hand off to implementation and your SREs. Please confirm owners/timeline against each item.

Implementation checklist (pilot, week 0 -> week 4):

Week 0 (pre-kickoff) — owners: Helio infra + Redwood infra
- Service account + read-only logs access (Helio infra)
- Provide sample traffic (1k requests/day) and agreed seed set (Helio product)
- Confirm data retention and redaction rules (security compliance)

Week 1 (integration) — owners: Redwood impl eng + Helio infra
- Wire eval harness endpoint to Redwood eval-runner (JIRA: INF-1209)
- Validate nightly job, smoke-run with 100 examples
- Configure metric reporting to Helio Slack channel (ops-alerts)

Week 2 (canary ramp) — owners: Redwood runtime + Helio product
- Start staged rollout (10% traffic), capture baseline metrics
- Run parallel A/B evaluations on heldout prompt variants
- Activate regression tripwires (yellow thresholds)

Week 3-4 (monitor & iterate) — owners: CS + Helio product
- If critical alerts trigger, auto-rollback and trigger postmortem workflow
- Weekly quality review with prompt-set adjustments and model tuning

Open questions for Helio:
- Do you want nightly diffs delivered to S3 or to the Slack channel?
- Who owns the primary on-call during the canary days?

If this looks good I'll convert to a mutual action plan and push dates.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Li <evan.li@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-12T11:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope: regression monitoring and canary policies

Thanks Marissa — quick answers:

- Nightly diffs: S3 is preferred for our audit pipeline, but a daily summary to Slack is useful for the triage lead.
- On-call: Helio will provide primary on-call for the first canary week; we request Redwood provide a runbook entry and a secondary contact.

We'll also attach a canonical set of human judgments for a 200-example validation set by Monday. Expect the file upload to the Drive link you included.

Evan
Principal ML Engineer, Helio Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope: regression monitoring and canary policies

Samira/Evan — two commercial points to note as we finalize the pilot statement of work: 

1) Canary rollback SLA: for pilot customers we provide best-effort rollback tooling and operational support. If Helio requires guaranteed rollback windows or 24/7 on-call, we should scope as a short-term add-on.
2) Alert volume: if nightly diffs create >500 alerts/day from noisy prompt variants, we'll propose a short spike credit to help cover extra processing while we tune thresholds.

Happy to discuss during the kickoff.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@heliohealth.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Samira/Evan — thanks all for the quick turn. Final checklist items before kickoff Tuesday:

- Helio to upload the 200-example human judgment set to the Drive folder (link below) by Monday EOD.
- Confirm S3 bucket name and write credentials for nightly diffs.
- Approve the attached canary fallback doc (we'll mark the SLA notes as optional for pilot).

Proposed kickoff time: Tuesday 2028-10-16 10:00am PT — invite to follow (Redwood team: Jonas, Marissa, Monica, Ben; Helio: Samira, Evan, SRE representative).

Looking forward — we'll convert Marissa's checklist into a mutual action plan after the call.

Regards,
Monica Patel
